title: Normalize and validate a storage bay code on assignment
goal: Keep a storage bay code normalized and reject invalid assignments without maintaining a backing-field name.

applicability.sdk: 10.0.402 (verification baseline; .NET 10 SDK with C# 14 support required)
prerequisites: Target net10.0 with a supported .NET 10 SDK; no preview language mode or workloads required.
constraints: The field keyword is C# 14 syntax; use the explicit-field comparison for .NET 9 / C# 13.
Writing Code inside its own setter recursively invokes that setter. Write field instead.
A property initializer writes the backing field directly and does not execute the setter. The constructor deliberately assigns through Code.
This example has no synchronization; concurrent mutation needs a separate design.

evidence.scope: Original comparison; checks constructor validation, normalization, null/blank/length rejection and retained value. Refreshed by eng/Verify.ps1.
Original field-backed implementation; executes the same checks as the .NET 9 sample. Refreshed by eng/Verify.ps1.
